item.description: A 21-year-old Ocala woman was arrested outside a local bar after she allegedly led Marion County Sheriff’s Office deputies on a high-speed chase that reached speeds of over 100 miles per hour. Read more: ‘Y’all need faster cars’: Ocala woman arrested at bar after 100+ mph chase

item.title: I think we need to crack down on aggressive driving on State Road 200
item.description: "To the Editor: I am a 75 year-old retiree who drives on State Road 200 every day. Every day, there is some very aggressive driver sideswiping me and cutting me off, or someone coming fast behind me and tailgating me. My question is: Where are the Marion County Sheriff's deputies and Ocala Police Department? They need to crack down on aggressive driving. It is a very dangerous behavior. Driving on SR 200 is certainly not a pleasure." - An Ocala resident shares her opinion. Read more: I think we
